title: Arkret Moderation Evidence Objects
description: Defs-only canonical objects shared by signed moderation reports, MIMI report mapping and durable franking-proof Events. This schema depends only on primitive/common schemas and does not reference an Event or operation request schema.

evidence_package.description: Canonical encrypted moderation evidence-package descriptor. target_refs names exactly the report target at admission; recipient_public_key_ref and encrypted_to MUST be byte-identical and resolve to an authorized moderator key for the report's exact effective scope. reporter_signature covers the descriptor and referenced ciphertext. The encrypted material MUST contain only reporter-visible evidence for target_refs and MUST NOT contain Realm/Circle history keys, MLS epoch/exporter secrets or unrelated plaintext.

franking_proof.description: Canonical franking proof used both inside a moderation report and as the complete payload of an ak.moderation.franking_proof durable Event. event_id names the encrypted Event whose receipt is proven; the enclosing proof Event has its own distinct Event.event_id.

event_id.description: Event ID of the encrypted Event whose receipt is proven; not the enclosing franking-proof Event ID.

routing_metadata_digest.description: Digest of canonical Event routing metadata covered by the receiving service.

mls_group_id_digest.description: Digest of the MLS group id; raw group ids and plaintext epoch values are forbidden.

verification_method.description: Exact receiving-service verification method used for signature. Its controller MUST project to received_by and the method MUST be authorized at received_at.

replay_nonce.description: Opaque anti-replay nonce generated by the receiving service and covered by the proof signature.

signature.description: Receiving service signature over the canonical franking-proof transcript.
